justification: Empirical directional accuracy of global exchange opening signals (46.0% - 58.3%, overall mean ~51.8%) is statistically indistinguishable from unconditional base rates after Holm-Bonferroni correction (adjusted p > 0.05 across all horizons). Net expected value after 30 bps roundtrip friction is uniformly negative (-7 to -63 bps). While session filtering reduces trade frequency from 202 to 155 trades (saving friction drag), the signal provides no statistically significant incremental predictive alpha or positive economic edge.

empirical_findings.friction_drag_impact: 30 bps roundtrip nominal friction erodes gross edge across all exchange opening horizons
empirical_findings.patient_holding_impact: Patient holding and structural trailing stops reduce trade frequency from 1,184 to <30 trades, substantially cutting transaction cost drag
